claude_code_cloud.name: SwitchBot check-in sync
claude_code_cloud.prompt: Run SwitchBot check-in sync: read Make data store 229823 for check-in records (key not starting with map_, checked_in_at > 0). For each: (1) find Beds24 bookingId where bookingId % 1000000 == key_id — query GET https://beds24.com/api/v2/bookings?arrivalFrom=2025-01-01&arrivalTo=2027-12-31 (proxy injects auth); (2) if booking has no CHECKIN infoItem, POST to https://beds24.com/api/v2/bookings with [{id: bookingId, infoItems: [{code: "CHECKIN", text: "Checked in via SwitchBot at <checked_in_at converted to JST YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm>"}]}]; (3) load ArtifactData tool via ToolSearch then update artifact GeFRLVdrhqj2CnkyHzw4bu stays collection — find stay where unit matches and checked_in_at ms epoch falls between stay.in*1000 and stay.out*1000 (or in/out are ISO dates), set checkedIn: true, checkedInAt: <checked_in_at ms>. All three steps are idempotent — skip if already done. Post to the hearthbot thread only if a new check-in was processed or if there is an error to report. Crest House units: 101, 201, 301. checked_in_at is in milliseconds.
